attributes.residual:
THE WORK ORDER'S PREMISE IS REFUTED BY DIRECT MEASUREMENT. It states that the inverse direction (ours is the copy, target is the `li`) blocks camera_mode_level. It does not. Classifying every differing word of camera_mode_level against build/GUNE5D/src/game/world/.postprocess/body/camera.o and build/GUNE5D/obj/game/world/camera.o gives 582/582 insns, 32 differing words: 27 pure register fields, 4 `other`, and exactly ONE copy-form site - at +0x8b0, ours ('li',27,0) against the target's ('copy',29,30). That is the FORWARD arrow (ours li, target copy) with a DESTINATION MISMATCH, r27 against r29. camera_mode_level carries ZERO inverse-direction sites; it did not appear in the image-wide inverse census at all. Building the inverse direction therefore cannot and did not move this function, and the run-25 lane brief's linkage of the two was wrong.

WHAT IT ACTUALLY NEEDS IS UNCHANGED FROM CN'S RECORD, which reproduces exactly. The +0x8b0 site is the combined form-plus-recolor stage (LZ's 'v2 requirement'), which remains unbuilt. The census puts that stage's image-wide population at 44 fwd_rc + 47 inv_rc = 91 sites against 7 for the two pure-form arrows combined, so it is worth 13x the direction work and is the correct next postprocessor target. The other 4 `other` words are CN's two permutation pairs: +0x740/+0x744 (cluster A, rule-ready, order [1,0]) and +0x8c0/+0x8c4 (cluster C, legal only AFTER the recolor, which the permute->form->recolor stage order cannot express).

ONE CORRECTION OFFERED TO CN, NOT A CONTRADICTION. CN concludes the remainder 'is not a bijective renaming either', citing verify_consistent_recolor's refusal at +0x8b8 (`use of g27 does not correspond to g29 under the running renaming`) as evidence that the target COALESCES two of our webs. That refusal has exactly the shape this session proved misleading on atree::fn_8001267C, where an identical-looking message at +0x1c8 was NOT a coalescing but a plain two-web TRANSPOSITION whose defining words were byte-identical, so the checker's forward inference committed to the identity map and then refused a legitimate swapped use 0x50 bytes later. The coalescing diagnosis here was drawn the same way and should be RE-DERIVED before it is relied on: walk back to the last definition of our r27 and our r29 and check whether those defining words are byte-identical to the target's. If they are, a permutation window over the definition pair may dissolve the refusal, and one of CN's three reasons this function is unreachable would fall. This does NOT by itself close camera_mode_level - the +0x8b0 form-plus-recolor blocker is independent and real - so the function stays parked.
